'''Republic storage depot AB-119''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] storage depot built in a cave in the [[Whiterock Wastes]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> During the [[Galactic War]], a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] working with the Republic was deceived by [[Languss Tuno]], who was posing as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], into [[Raid on Republic storage depot AB-119|attacking]] the facility to steal [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. After destroying the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] protecting the facility and retrieving the sensors, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] was confronted by Republic [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Kollis]].<ref name="Deals and Double Deals">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Deals and Double Deals|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>
